review_method: Read frozen theory/contracts, implementation and focused tests; inspect preserved raw numerical outcomes and recompute summary comparisons from existing outputs. No numerical suite, quadrature or benchmark rerun.
scope: Standalone opt-in cached streamed-QR residual diagnostic on bounded synthetic consistent/self-adjoint fixtures; algebra-only inconsistent-cache case kept separate.
implementation_checks: Two passes form C, delta row and row-block[d,E] using J consistently. No full E/A allocation, Hamiltonian callback, Gram norm, rank truncation or R inversion.
Complex conjugation, nonorthogonal-coordinate correction, eta-major outputs, explicit W and synthetic CLI behavior agree with contract.
QR norms and scalar bounds are checked against independently formed direct residuals and dense resolvent solves on consistent caches. Solve defect and no outward certification are explicit.
Baseline active runner and refinement policy are not modified. NPZ cache loading and workspace exclusions are disclosed.
claim_ceiling: Floating-point conditional diagnostic, not rigorous outward-rounded certificate.
Observed benchmark is one local synthetic N512,m32,P6003 comparison; production speed and memory fit remain unmeasured.
Actual Unit5 physical checkpoint/refinement remains unchanged.
next_action: Publish scoped code/evidence and retain standalone opt-in postprocessor; no production activation is admitted by this review.
